profile.silhouette: tortoise: rigid domed scute shell and overhanging rim, low plastron, splayed sturdy short legs, blunt beaked head on an articulated neck, tiny pointed tail and digging claws
profile.locomotion: slow and faster supported four-beat travel with splayed whole-leg articulation; rigid shell, low recovery and no mammalian gallop
profile.attack: native Attack-informed neck recoil, angular forward bite and jaw snap over four braced feet; exaggerated native jumps/spins are omitted

bounds.source: bind hierarchy plus opaque plate envelopes

geometry.closure: every member and connector is a closed opaque shape; connector gaskets bridge continuous core masses

compositingPolicy.sortWithinGroup: camera-relative depth, far-to-near, then stable ID
compositingPolicy.bilateralSwap: absolute left/right plates are assigned near/far from projected camera depth at each heading

attack.motionSemantics: Attack-informed braced snapping bite: neck recoil, fast angular extension, jaw closure and recovery over four fixed soles

walkA.motionSemantics: slow lateral-sequence four-beat crawl, .80 duty and at least three grounded feet, low splayed foot recovery

run.motionSemantics: faster supported crawl, .80 duty and at least three grounded feet; quicker longer steps, rigid shell and no gallop or aerial run

idle.motionSemantics: Idle_2-informed low four-foot tortoise, small breathing/head motion; shell remains rigid

walk.motionSemantics: slow lateral-sequence four-beat crawl, .80 duty and at least three grounded feet, low splayed foot recovery
